title: Civil Cadet Drafter - QLD (Req 260000H5)
content_text:
Civil Cadet Drafter - QLD - ( 260000H5 )
Description
Our QLD Water team is looking for two Cadet Drafters to work with experienced engineers, designers and drafters to deliver practical drafting solutions across a variety of water engineering projects.
As a Cadet Drafter, you will work on water-based projects and:
Learn all facets of CAD, drafting and design techniques and gain skills in relevant computer programs.
Work under the guidance of our engineers and designers on engineering projects; and
Provide accurate and efficient drafting services for the business unit in accordance with project timeframes and budgets.
What we provide
Access to a global developing professionals network, providing opportunities to grow your career, build connections and participate in activities across the business. Developing Professionals Group (stantec.com) (https://www.stantec.com/au/careers/developing-professionals-group)
Exposure to industry leaders, projects and partnerships with leading QLD water organisations.
Flexible work arrangements and employee benefits, including a mental health program, salary packaging, an Employee Assistance Program, and a rewards and benefits program.
The opportunity to work collaboratively with colleagues from other disciplines within a large multidisciplinary organisation.
Support to balance hands-on, work-based training with formal study through TAFE, helping you develop real-world skills while working towards your qualifications.
The chance to be part of an inclusive, collaborative and diverse team, while developing your skills and knowledge and shaping your career in engineering.
Why Stantec?
The Stantec community brings together more than 34,000 employees across over 450 locations on six continents. We collaborate across disciplines and industries to bring buildings, energy, resources, water, environmental, transport and infrastructure projects to life. From initial project concepts and planning through to design, construction and commissioning, our work begins at the intersection of community, creativity and client relationships.
Communities are fundamental. Whether around the corner or across the globe, they provide a foundation, a sense of place and a sense of belonging. That is why, at Stantec, we always design with community in mind. We care about the communities we serve because they are our communities too. We are designers, engineers, scientists and project managers, innovating together at the intersection of community, creativity and client relationships. Balancing these priorities results in projects that improve quality of life in communities across the globe.
Qualifications
Qualifications
Completed your QCE or equivalent, with strong academic performance in mathematics, engineering and English, or completed or currently enrolled in one of the following:
Diploma of Engineering, Advanced Diploma of Engineering, or Associate Degree in Civil Engineering.
If you do not already hold one of these qualifications, the company will support the successful candidate to complete the Associate Degree in Civil Engineering at TAFE Queensland South Bank.
Some experience, or a keen interest, in drafting and design within the civil and structural engineering space.
The ability to gain and apply knowledge of engineering drawing techniques and CAD packages.
Intermediate skills in Microsoft Office, including Word and Excel.
Good interpersonal skills and the ability to work effectively within a team environment.
The ability to solve problems and manage your time effectively.
How to apply
Please submit the following:
CV
Cover letter
Academic transcript
If you are currently enrolled at TAFE, please submit a copy of your academic transcript. Otherwise, please provide your Year 11 and Year 12 report cards.

mandatory_requirements_notes: Entry Level, full-time, two cadet positions. Requires QCE or equivalent, OR completed/enrolled Diploma/Advanced Diploma of Engineering or Associate Degree in Civil Engineering (Marc's Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design is close but not the exact named qualification); some experience or keen interest in civil/structural drafting; CAD aptitude; intermediate MS Office. No citizenship/PR or years-of-experience requirement stated. No closing date shown; posted 9 Jul 2026 but still listed in the live Australia search with Apply Now on 6 Oct 2026. Concerns: aimed at school leavers/TAFE students with study support (cadet pay likely below Marc's band); water drafting (not roads); requires relocation to Brisbane; Subclass 485 ends Dec 2027 vs a permanent cadet role with Associate Degree pathway.
